endpoint_audit.alpha_zero: Valid nonexpansive q=1 extension at h=2/beta. Source kappa=beta/alpha expression is undefined here; advertise parameter-form extension, not literal kappa identity.
endpoint_audit.alpha_equals_beta: For beta>0, h=1/beta and q=0. T is constant from derivative zero; no minimizer input needed. Scalar minimax optimality remains valid.
endpoint_audit.dimension_zero: All pairwise distances vanish. Do not infer alpha<=beta from form bounds without Nontrivial E. Explicit alpha<=beta in optimal theorem is a parameter-domain condition; no hidden dimension positivity. Rayleigh iSup over E includes zero and works.
endpoint_audit.beta_positive: Together with alpha>=0 makes alpha+beta>0 and the optimal step defined; excludes alpha=beta=0, whose envelope is identically1 for every finite step.
endpoint_audit.alpha_le_beta: Needed to identify nonnegative q and match source condition number >=1; for nontrivial space follows from lower/upper Hessian bounds, but explicit hypothesis is correct on all dimensions.
endpoint_audit.signed_endpoint_bound: M(h)>=0 automatically. No alpha<=beta needed if theorem only derives a norm envelope from existing compatible bounds; singleton case remains harmless.
endpoint_audit.minimax: Uniform two-endpoint envelope minimizer; may be nonunique when alpha=0. Do not claim unique minimizer, actual norm optimality for every function, oracle optimality or iterate complexity.
